proof.text: Use the epimorphism S.g from short exactness and exteriorTensor_quotient_exists to obtain an epi q from the tensor with the exterior sheaf of lifts to the tensor with the exterior sheaf of the quotient, together with its formula on wedge sections.

Apply determinant_liftWedge_kernel_exists to construct the concatenated wedge map w on the source of q and prove kernel.ι q ≫ w = 0. This is the independence-of-lifts part of the determinant paragraph, before passage to the quotient.

Set phi = Abelian.epiDesc q w hwzero. Mathlib comp_epiDesc gives q ≫ phi = w. Given tuples a,b,c with S.g(c_i)=b_i, replace b by the tuple of images, use the formula for q, evaluate q ≫ phi = w on the tensor of the a- and c-wedges, and apply the formula for w. This proves the unchanged displayed conclusion. The supplied family is not needed because descent constructs a global map independently.
